RAJYA  SABHA

List of Questions for  ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday,  the April 24, 2008/Vaisakha 4, 1930 (Saka)

(Ministries: Prime Minister; Atomic Energy; Coal; Communications and
Information Technology; Development of North Eastern Region;
Environment and Forests; External Affairs; Housing and Urban
Poverty Alleviation; Overseas Indian Affairs; Panchayati Raj;
Parliamentary Affairs; Personnel, Public Grievances and
Pensions; Planning; Shipping, Road Transport and
 Highways; Space; Statistics and Programme
Implementation;  Urban Development;
Y outh Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions  20
139
Domestic call charges
*441. SHRI RAJEEV
CHANDRASEKHAR:
SHRI M.V . MYSURA
REDDY:
Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether TRAI has decided to do
away with levying Access Deficit Charges
(ADC) on telecom operators as a result of
which domestic call (Local and STD)
charges would become cheaper; and
(b) if so, to what extent domestic calls
are likely to become cheaper and the likely
new rates to be fixed by various telecom
operators, including the BSNL and MTNL,
and by when are they likely to be made
effective?
Reduction of forest cover
area
*442. SHRI KAMAL AKHTAR:
SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
the forest cover in the country has been
decreasing rapidly during the last few
years;
(b) if so, the details thereof, State-wise,
year-wise;
(c) whether any evaluation has been
done of decrease in forest areas through the
Joint Forest Management; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and the
achievements in the protection of forests
made so far, State-wise?

140
Small Savings Scheme of
Post Offices
*443. SHRI A. ELA V ARASAN: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is
negative growth in Small Savings Scheme
of Post Offices with huge withdrawals over
deposits into such schemes in the last
year;
(b) whether it is also a fact that this
negative growth will lead to a drastic deficit
in National Social Security Fund
(NSSF);
(c) if so, whether Government has
analysed the reasons for this negative
growth;
(d) the steps taken by Government for
the growth of this scheme; and
(e) the details thereof?
Irrigation project of lower Painganga
in Maharashtra
*444. SHRIMATI BRINDA KARAT:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that around
95 villages, including 45 tribal villages
and approximately 1100 acres of forest
land, is being affected and 2 lakh trees are
to be cut down due to the proposed
irrigation project of lower Painganga in
Maharashtra;
(b) whether any alternative non-
displacing schemes for irrigation have been
identified;
(c) whether the Ministry has given
clearance for the said project; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Agreement for collection of toll tax on
NHs
*445. SHRI  RAM JETHMALANI:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that with regard
to various projects under an agreement
reached between private agencies collecting
toll tax on National Highways and
representatives of Government, the
collector of toll tax shares a certain
percentage of revenue with Government;
and
(b) if so, the details thereof and names
of the projects on which the above
agreement is in place as on March, 2008
with percentage of revenues to be earned
by Government?
Condition of roads under
NHDP
*446. SHRI KANJIBHAI PA TEL: Will
the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether complaints have been
received by Government regarding bad
condition of roads under National
Highways Development Project (NHDP);
and
(b) if so, the number thereof and the
steps taken by the National Highways
Authority of India (NHAI) for redressal of
the same?
Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

141
Biological diversity
*447. DR. K. MALAISAMY: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) the various measures to popularise
the concept of Biological diversity;
(b) the various kinds of institutions
concerned over Research and Development
of Bio-diversity and the role of the National
Bio-Diversity Authority; and
(c) whether the conservation aspect of
Bio-diversity would offend or put a hurdle
on the growth and development of
medicinal plants, herbal plants used for
health care?
Access deficit charges earned by
BSNL
*448. SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) the quantum of Access Deficit
Charges earned by BSNL during the years
2001-02 to 2007-08, year-wise; and
(b) whether it is a fact that the access
deficit charges, so earned were being used
by BSNL for providing and maintaining
telephonic services to rural and remote
areas?
Missing ship carrying Indian crew
*449. SHRI AMAR SINGH:
SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that M.V . Cargo
vessel which was carrying 25 Indian crew
was reportedly missing since February 18,
2008 while on its way from Nororossisk in
Russia to Bartin in Turkey;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government had received
any petition from the families of the crew;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the action taken thereon?
Steps to reduce urban poverty
*450. SHRI S. ANBALAGAN: Will the
Minister of HOUSING AND URBAN
POVERTY ALLEVIATION be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of below poverty line
(BPL) people living in the urban areas of
the country at present, State-wise;
(b) the percentage of BPL people in the
total population of urban areas, State-wise;
(c) the reasons for continuous poverty
of large number of people despite the
schemes of the Union Government to
improve their lives; and
(d) the concrete steps proposed to be
taken by the Union Government to reduce
the increasing urban poverty in the
country?
Funds for maintenance of NH-54
*451. SHRI LALHMING LIANA: Will
the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) the amount of funds allocated for
maintenance of NH-54 during the last three
financial years;
(b) whether the funds allocated for
maintenance of NH-54 have not been
utilized at all; and
(c) if so, the reasons therefor?

142
Status of e-district project
*452. SHRI SHANT ARAM
LAXMAN NAIK : Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) the status of Government's e-district
project;
(b) the names of the services which are
proposed to be brought online under the
project;
(c) the names of the States in which the
project is being implemented; and
(d) the details of activities, finance
allotted and achievements, made, State-wise?
Housing policy and regulatory
measures for real estate
*453. SHRI PENUMALLI MADHU:
Will the Minister of HOUSING AND
URBAN POVERTY ALLEVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there is a national policy on
housing as the land prices are soaring and
the entry of FDI in real estate has made
housing out of reach of the ordinary people
including the middle class;
(b) whether there is any proposal with
Government to regulate private sector in
the real estate; and
(c) the regulatory measures
contemplated by Government for the real
estate?
MoU with Malaysia
*454. SHRI C. RAMACHAND-
RAIAH: Will the Minister of OVERSEAS
INDIAN AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is signing an
MoU with the Malaysian Government to
benefit the Indian emigrant workersun-
skilled, semiskilled and skilled;
(b) if so, the salient features of the said
MoU;
(c) whether any provision has also been
made in the said MoU to protect the
interests of the existing Indian workers who
are facing unsatisfactory working
conditions in Malaysia;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor alongwith
the measures taken, if any, to guard the
working conditions of Indian workers
there?
Use of in-flight mobile
services
*455. SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARWAL: W ill the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether use of in-flight mobile
services in India is being prohibited due to
security reasons;
(b) if so, the details in this regard;
(c) whether some private airlines have
sought Government's nod for use of mobile
services on board their aircrafts;
(d) if so, the names of such private
airlines with the details of reasons advanced
by them;
(e) whether Government would refer
such request to Intelligence Agencies;
and
(f) if not, the reasons therefor?

143
Demonstration by Tibetans
*456. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELW AL: Will the Minister of
EXTERNAL AFFAIRS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the attention of
Government has been drawn towards the
conflicts taking place between China and
Tibetans in Tibet;
(b) whether it is a fact that Tibetans
have demonstrated in many parts of India
to protest in that regard;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether it is also a fact that Tibetans
have been asked by Government to
curb their political activities in India;
and
(e) if so, the reasons therefor and the
role of Tibetans in the country?
Drinking water crisis in
Delhi
*457. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARW AL: W ill the Minister of
URBAN DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the crisis of drinking water
is still prevalent in the capital city of
Delhi;
(b) if so, the details alongwith causes
thereof;
(c) whether Central Government has
taken any measures to deal with problem
of drinking water in Delhi;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Payment of toll on NHs by State
roadways buses
*458. SHRI SANJAY RAUT : Will the
Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that State
roadways buses have been made to pay
expressway toll, which are being used
mostly by the poor; and
(b) whether Government is considering
to restrict express toll to private vehicles
only and exempt State roadways buses from
paying expressway toll?
Delay in completion of highway
projects
*459. MS. MABEL REBELLO:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has failed to meet even a single target in
highway projects in the country during
2007;
(b) whether the delays in completion
are proving expensive to the exchequer;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the status of completion of various
highway projects in Orissa and Jharkhand
at the end of 2007?
Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

144
Length of National Highways
*460. SHRI RAMACHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of
SHIPPING, ROAD TRANSPORT AND
HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) the total length of National
N

Highways in the country in kilometres;
(b) the details thereof, State-wise; and
(c) whether it is a fact that Orissa,
Jammu and Kashmir  and North-East States
have less number and shortest length of
National Highways in the country?
